newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates at mostly steady levels on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates at mostly steady levels on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted mostly steady at St. Louis Merchants Exchange on Tuesday.
No barges traded versus none Monday.
- Two barges, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), next week, bid 90 percent of tariff, unchanged from Monday, no offer.
- One barge, Illinois River, Mt Vernon, Ill., next week, bid 110 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois, next week, no bid, offered at 175 percent.
- Two barges, Lower Ohio River, Grain or Product, next week, bid 115 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, Ohio, next week, bid 115 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, Roll Top, St Louis, Mississippi, next week, bid 95 percent, no offer.
- One barge, Lift Top Brake, Seneca, Ill., Constructive Placement, by 0700 February 6, bid 175 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, Lower Ohio, two each week of February 16 and 23, bid 110 percent, offer 120 percent.
